sources.title: Copper-clad laminate material chain note for PCB manufacturing
sources.content: Copper-clad laminate is an upstream material input used in printed circuit board manufacturing. The material activity is therefore upstream_of PCB manufacturing in the selected industry chain. sources.title: HDI route and AI-server PCB design context
sources.content: HDI is a printed circuit board technical route associated with higher interconnect density. AI-server designs can require advanced PCB routing and signal-integrity capability. The fixture supports a Technology or Product node and a bounded qualitative view, with no market-size, growth, utilization, price, or penetration value.

sources.title: Public PCB industry risk and monitoring context
sources.content: PCB manufacturing research should monitor customer concentration, material availability, technology qualification, and cyclicality. These are research risks and gaps to disclose, not quantified forecasts.
